description: This file defines a final class `Encoding` with static methods for reading, decoding, and encoding strings, primarily used for buffer manipulation and serialization within the AWS CRT internal namespace.

classes.name: Encoding
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string encoding and decoding operations on buffers.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a length-prefixed string from the buffer, advancing the buffer accordingly.

methods.name: readStrings
methods.description: Reads multiple length-prefixed strings from the buffer until the buffer is exhausted.

methods.name: decodeString
methods.description: Decodes a length-prefixed string from the buffer, returning the length and string.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string into a length-prefixed format, suitable for buffer serialization.
